_comment: Pins RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.6 items 4 and 5 through RFC-MACP-0010 Section 5.1. The offer is accepted at acceptance time 1000; the bound policy's implicit_accept_timeout_ms is 1000, so the deadline is 2000. The Commitment is evaluated at 2500, after the deadline, and nothing else ran in between: no timer or sweep is required, so the runtime MUST observe the deadline at that evaluation and append the synthetic HandoffAccept before evaluating the Commitment (item 5). expected_history pins it immediately before the Commitment. Every Envelope timestamp_unix_ms is 0, so a runtime that measured the timeout on the Envelope clock (contrary to item 4 and Section 5.1(1)) would find no deadline elapsed, emit no synthetic accept, and reject the positive Commitment. A suspend/resume variant is omitted: SessionSuspend and SessionResume are emitted by the runtime through the SuspendSession/ResumeSession RPCs and MUST NOT be submitted via Send (RFC-MACP-0001 Section 7.5), and every fixture step is a Send-submitted envelope.
description: Handoff Mode: the synthetic HandoffAccept is due and appended before a Commitment evaluated after the implicit-accept deadline.

policy.description: Implicit accept after 1000 ms of unanswered offer; initiator-only commitment.

messages._comment: Acceptance time 2500 is past the deadline of 2000. The positive Commitment depends on h1 being accepted, which only the synthetic HandoffAccept supplies.

expected_history._comment: RFC-MACP-0010 Section 5.1(3): Envelope sender is the target, implicit is true and accepted_by is the target.
